what I received from this lovely doctor was just so unexpected ! She looked into my problem in detail though the other doctors also do that but there was something very calming and assuring about her demeanour and I immediately relaxed as I was initially rather tense a) because I didn’t know her and b) was having a bad day of health ..
dr Hakim was very caring and I came out of that meeting relaxed and felt she had really addressed my health issue ..
to be honest all doctors in this surgery are excellent and give proper care and diagonis but I have come to realise it’s what we are putting out as patients that really works against us ..  we are not open and receptive to new doctors and new methods or techniques and unless we are open and accept that change is really a good thing and there are others in the practice who are also excellent we patients will always have a problem ..

I have accompanied them for most of their appointments over this time... of which there have been MANY, increasingly so as they get older now. We have only had positive experiences, with the wonderful attentive doctors, the nurses and the reception staff. I feel like they've always received the care they needed, especially when its been an urgent matter.
Whenever I hear people grumble about healthcare in their area, I brag about the amazing practice my parents are patients at and how grateful we are for this!

I strongly feel that all the negative ratings on here are not at all indicative of the high standard of this practice. In general I find that people are far more likely to write a negative review when they're unhappy than write a positive review for all the times they are happy.

Also, the new appointment booking system is absolutely fantastic, and we always get an appointment in such a fair time frame according to the need.
Thank you team SMP for being brilliant!
